extracted.name: Lemon chicken soup
extracted.description: Use up your leftover roast chicken to make this moreish lemon chicken soup. With added risotto rice, it's a healthy and filling dinner for four
ingredient_lines: 2 large leeks halved, washed and finely sliced
300g leftover roast chicken shredded and skin removed
instruction_lines: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the leeks and celery, and fry for 8-10 mins until softened. Stir in the chicken stock and bring to the boil, add the rice and chicken, turn down the heat to medium and simmer for 15-20 mins until the rice is cooked through, stirring occasionally.

Take off the heat and leave to cool slightly for 10-15 mins (so the eggs don’t scramble), and rapidly whisk in the eggs and lemon juice until the mixture looks creamy. Serve in bowls and top with dill, if you like.
categories: How to use up leftover chicken
